title: Registration exemption for administering vaccine under 105 CMR 700.003(F)
rule_summary: Among the exemptions from the requirement to register in 105 CMR 700.004(B), 105 CMR 700.004(B)(7) provides that a health care professional duly licensed or certified by the Department or a student duly enrolled in an approved or accredited program for such licensure or certification and authorized by 105 CMR 700.003(F) to possess and administer vaccine is exempt from registration for purposes of administering vaccine pursuant to 105 CMR 700.003(F).
exam_relevance: Tests that a health care professional or student authorized by 105 CMR 700.003(F) to possess and administer vaccine is exempt from registration, and that the exemption is for purposes of administering vaccine pursuant to 105 CMR 700.003(F).

authority.name: Massachusetts Department of Public Health regulations

common_confusions: Assuming a separate Department registration is needed before administering vaccine under 105 CMR 700.003(F).
Extending the exemption to administering vaccine other than pursuant to 105 CMR 700.003(F).
verification_notes: Read in the current 105 CMR 700.000 publication on mass.gov, the document generated 2024-02-02, on 2026-09-14.
